'''Drayton''' was a commentator on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Drayton commented on the entry for [[LaserHone/Legends|LaserHone's]] [[Talon vibrodagger]], pointing out that it was a handy tool for slicing open [[magna-seal]]s that could be found on cargo crates.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
